title: WhatsApp Desktop data
whyItMatters: WhatsApp stores local chat caches, media and session state. The folder reveals that the account was used on this Mac.
source: WhatsApp Desktop macOS artifacts under Library/Application Support - https://www.group-ib.com/blog/whatsapp-forensic-artifacts/
notes: Newer sandboxed builds use ~/Library/Containers/desktop.WhatsApp/Data/Library/Application Support/WhatsApp instead; that variant is not matched here. No content read.
